name: Errors
description: kafka_network_requestmetrics_count{name=ErrorsPerSec, error!=NONE}, by error type, 2-minute timeshift delta.
programText:
raw = data('kafka_network_requestmetrics_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('name', 'ErrorsPerSec') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker')).sum(by=['error'])
((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Errors')
